title: Microsoft Teams: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams
description: Express voice enrollment makes registering your voice in Teams fast and easy. Your profile enables features like voice isolation, speaker recognition, identification in a meeting room and transcripts, and enhanced meeting recaps and insights from Microsoft 365 Copilot. If you don’t yet have a voice profile, just go to the recognition tab in Teams settings and opt-in to enroll your voice from audio during your Teams meetings. Admins can enable or disable this feature.
